title: How a Godly Man Pursues a Woman Without Chasing Her
caption:
Matthew 6:33 didn't say seek her first and God gets added to you. Get the order backward and you're building on sand.

A man chasing God doesn't need to chase anyone else. Desperation has a smell. So does a man actually walking with Him, and it draws without trying.

Build in private what you'd want her to find in public. Fix what's actually broken in you before you fix your dating life.

Pray for who you're becoming before you pray for who you're marrying. God builds the man first. The marriage is what he's ready for after.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #relationships #discipline
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
